info.description: Complete collection for HR Management API testing with all endpoints including Office Locations, Work Shifts, Attendance, and S3 uploads.

item.name: Create Organization
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

POST /api/admin/organizations

Creates organization + first admin user. Response organization includes expires_at (default ~6 months from creation).

item.name: Create Org Admin (Existing Org)
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

POST /api/admin/organizations/:orgId/admin

Creates an additional admin user for an existing organization.

Body:
{"admin_name":"Jane Smith","admin_email":"admin2@betaindustries.com"}

item.name: List Organizations
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

GET /api/admin/organizations

Paginated list; each organization row includes expires_at and max_users.

item.name: Update Organization Status
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

PATCH /api/admin/organizations/:id/status

Allowed values for body.status:
- ACTIVE (reactivate organization)
- INACTIVE (disable organization access)

Example bodies:
{"status":"INACTIVE"}
{"status":"ACTIVE"}

When INACTIVE, tenant login/select-org will not allow users from that organization to proceed.

Note: INACTIVE is manual. Time-based access is controlled separately via expires_at (see Update Organization Expiry).

item.name: Update Organization Expiry
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

PATCH /api/admin/organizations/:id/expiry

Body:
- expires_at (required): ISO 8601 datetime

Response: updated organization including expires_at.

Manual test:
1. PATCH a past expires_at (e.g. 2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z) then POST /api/auth/login or any {{tokenB}} request — expect 403 "Organization has expired".
2. PATCH a future expires_at — tenant access works again.

New organizations default to expires_at ≈ 6 months after created_at.

item.name: Update Organization Privileged Settings (Superadmin)
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

PATCH /api/admin/organizations/:id/settings

Allowed body fields:
- face_clock_enabled (boolean)
- kyc_flow_enabled (boolean)

Notes:
- Tenant org admins/HR/managers cannot update these flags via /api/organizations (it returns 403).
- Defaults for both flags are false; this endpoint is how superadmins enable/disable them per org.

item.name: Update Organization User Limit
item.description:
Super admin only endpoint.

PATCH /api/admin/organizations/:id/user-limit

Body:
- max_users (required): integer >= 1

Response: updated organization including max_users.

Manual test:
1. PATCH max_users to a low value (e.g. 2).
2. Create non-admin users until cap — expect 403 "Maximum user limit reached for this organization. Please contact your administrator." on POST /api/users, POST /api/users/devices, onboarding start, reverse-onboarding invite.
3. POST /api/users with role admin still succeeds (admins do not count toward the limit).
4. Raise max_users — creates succeed again.

Default max_users for new orgs is 50.

item.name: Select Organization
item.description:
Exchanges selection_token + org_id for tenant JWT.

Response `user.location_tracking_enabled` (boolean): effective continuous GPS tracking for the selected user (user override wins; else department flag; else false).

Fails with 403 when:
- Organization is inactive or deleted ("Organization is inactive")
- Organization is past expires_at ("Organization has expired")
- User is inactive

item.name: List Switchable Organizations
item.description:
Admin/HR only.

GET /api/auth/switchable-orgs

Returns organizations where the caller has admin or hr role with the same official_email, org is active/not expired, and must_change_password is false.

Response: { current_org_id, organizations: [{ org_id, name, company_code, logo_url, role, is_current }] }

Related: POST /api/users/cross-org-sync clones/syncs an admin/hr from another org into the current org by email (see User Management → Cross-Org Sync Admin/HR).

item.name: Switch Organization
item.description:
Admin/HR only.

POST /api/auth/switch-org

Body:
- org_id (required, uuid)
- refresh_token (optional; current session refresh token to revoke)

Revokes refresh tokens for the current user, issues a new tenant JWT + refresh_token for the target org (same official_email, admin/hr role).

400 when org_id is already the active org.
403 when switch is not allowed or target requires password reset.

request.description:
POST /api/users/cross-org-sync

Auth: admin or hr in the **current (target) org**.

Creates (or updates) an admin/hr user in the current org from an existing admin/hr account with the same email in another org, then full-clones person/employment/compliance data.

Body:
- email (required): official_email of the source admin/hr
- role (required): admin | hr

Eligibility:
- role=admin: source onboarding_status may be PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, or COMPLETED
- role=hr: source onboarding_status must be COMPLETED

Cloned: profile, addresses, contacts, identities, bank, all documents, full payroll, employment/CTC, benefits, salary structures (component codes remapped), onboarding/KYC flags, designation/DOJ/names.
Not cloned: department_id, manager_id, shift_id, employee_id.

Password is reused from the source account. Continuous sync keeps siblings updated after later writes.

Errors:
- 404: no source admin/hr in another org
- 400: HR requested but source onboarding not COMPLETED
- 409: email already exists in current org as non-admin/hr

item.name: Employee Exit (Admin/HR)
item.description:
Offboard employees without deleting user rows. `users.deleted_at` is never set on exit; leave, attendance, payroll, and document history stay linked to the same user_id.

Paths:
- Notice: Initiate → employee stays ON_NOTICE with full app access through last_working_day (IST) → optional Confirm OR server auto-complete the calendar day after last_working_day → INACTIVE + sessions revoked
- Immediate: skip notice, INACTIVE in one call
- Cancel: revert ON_NOTICE → ACTIVE

Auto-complete: in-process daily scheduler (startup + every 24h); no Postman request. Activity log EXIT_AUTO_CONFIRMED; confirmed_by may be null.

Auth: admin or hr only. Cannot exit admin or device roles.

POST /api/users/:userId/exit

Initiates exit. Past last_working_day → immediate COMPLETED. Future notice_start_date → SCHEDULED (user stays ACTIVE until that date). Otherwise ON_NOTICE.

Body:
- exit_type (required)
- last_working_day (required): YYYY-MM-DD
- exit_reason (optional)
- notice_start_date (optional): if after today IST, exit is SCHEDULED

notice_start_date must be <= last_working_day when both set.

Response 201: `{ "exit": { ... } }`

item.name: Confirm Exit

POST /api/users/:userId/exit/confirm

Finalizes notice-period exit: user status → INACTIVE, exit status → COMPLETED, exited_at set. Revokes refresh tokens, consumes password-reset tokens, disables push device tokens. Auto-rejects PENDING leave with start_date after last_working_day. Does not set deleted_at.

item.name: Immediate Exit

Terminates in one step: exit status COMPLETED, user INACTIVE, tokens revoked.

Body:
- exit_type (required)
- exit_reason (optional)
- last_working_day (optional, YYYY-MM-DD): same format as POST /exit. When omitted, defaults to today (IST).

Auto-rejects PENDING leave with start_date after last_working_day.

item.name: Cancel Exit

Cancels notice-period exit: user status → ACTIVE, exit row → CANCELLED. Only valid while user is ON_NOTICE.

request.description:
UI flow: Regularize attendance by correcting a single punch time (clock-in or clock-out).

This endpoint now accepts multipart/form-data so you can upload the proof attachment directly:

item.name: Apply Leave (Happy Path)
item.description:
Standard 2-day leave application. Should return 201 with status=PENDING.

day_session is optional and defaults to FULL. It also accepts FIRST_HALF or SECOND_HALF to book half a day, in which case total_days is 0.5 and only 0.5 is deducted from the leave quota. A half-day is only valid when start_date equals end_date; a non-FULL session across a date range is rejected with HTTP 400.

Half-day requests require the applicant to have a configured work shift with start_time and end_time. On success the response includes session_window: with a valid break, FIRST_HALF and SECOND_HALF are split at the working-time midpoint (equal work minutes, break excluded from the count); without break, split is at clock midpoint (start + end) / 2.

item.name: Apply Half-Day Leave (First Half)
item.description: Books only the first half of 2035-09-01. Should return 201 with total_days = 0.5 and session_window derived from the user's work shift (shift start to working-time or clock midpoint). Returns HTTP 400 if tokenC has no shift with start_time and end_time configured. Saves the new id to halfDayLeaveRequestId.

item.name: Apply Half-Day Leave (Second Half, Same Date)
item.description: Run this after 'Apply Half-Day Leave (First Half)'. Opposite halves of the same date do not conflict, so this also returns 201. Together the two requests consume 1.0 day of quota.

item.name: Apply Half-Day Leave (Duplicate Half - Expect 409)
item.description: Repeats FIRST_HALF on a date that already has a FIRST_HALF request. The same session collides, so this returns HTTP 409 with conflict_request_ids.

item.name: Apply Half-Day Leave (Multi-Date - Expect 400)
item.description: A half-day session spanning more than one date is rejected by the validator with HTTP 400 and the message 'A half-day leave must start and end on the same date'.

item.name: Get Leave Request by ID
item.description: Get details of a specific leave request. Employees can view their own requests; admin/hr/manager can view any request in their org. Response includes session_window for half-day requests when the employee has a configured shift (working-time midpoint split when break is valid; clock midpoint otherwise).

item.name: Update Leave Request
item.description:
Update a pending leave request. Only the request owner can update, and only if status is PENDING. Re-validates overlap and quota checks.

day_session is optional; when omitted the existing session is kept. Changing it recomputes total_days (0.5 for FIRST_HALF or SECOND_HALF) and re-runs the session-aware overlap check against the final dates. Half-day updates return session_window when shift start/end are configured (working-time midpoint split when break is valid; clock midpoint otherwise).

item.name: Update Leave Request to Half-Day
item.description: Converts an existing pending full-day request into a half-day. The dates are collapsed to a single date in the same call, since a non-FULL session spanning multiple dates is rejected. Response total_days becomes 0.5.

item.name: Cancel Leave Request
